events.name: VO2max 5×3 + Endurance
events.notes: 5 × 3 min at 108% FTP with equal easy spinning between. Hard but even: the last rep should match the first, with HR reaching about 158+ bpm by the end. If you cannot hold a rep, drop 3% for the rest of the set instead of stopping. Then settle into steady zone 2. Short on time? Cut the endurance, not the main set.

events.name: VO2max 5×3 + Endurance
events.notes: 5 × 3 min at 110% FTP with equal easy spinning between. Hard but even: the last rep should match the first, with HR reaching about 158+ bpm by the end. If you cannot hold a rep, drop 3% for the rest of the set instead of stopping. Then settle into steady zone 2. Short on time? Cut the endurance, not the main set.

events.name: Endurance 105
events.notes: Steady zone 2 with short tempo lifts to stay engaged. Conversational throughout, and HR should stay near or below 135 bpm outside the lifts. Ease off if it drifts higher.

events.name: Ramp Test
events.notes: Come in rested and ride to failure. New FTP = 75% of your best 1-minute power. Zwift's built-in Ramp Test works too. Update FTP in both Zwift and Intervals.icu afterwards, or workout targets will differ between them. Stop immediately if you feel unwell.
